title: Gluten-Free Bowtie Pasta with Smoked Flavor
description: A gluten-free pasta dish with a smoky twist, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the flavors of smoked ingredients with the simplicity of bowtie pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bowtie pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the yum over medium heat.
Add the smoke to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cold to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water and then drain the bowtie pasta.
Add the pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce, adding some reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too thick.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with the yum.
